notes: Where a pipe or conduit segment counts as laid (Framework 0.100.0). A segment joins its line only on a tile that carries one of the conditions a support names and none of the forbidden ones, with a matching object standing there, installed and intact. The rule named default covers every line (process water, gas, acid, ethanol, irrigation and coolant); a rule named after a line family id, such as PhobosFramework.ProcessWater or PhobosFramework.GasLine, applies to that family instead. Condition names are the game's own. Player files in BepInEx/config/PhobosFramework/lines override entries by name; a list you set replaces the shipped list.

default.notes: Floor, as before, and since 0.100.0 inside a wall, where a ship's own conduit runs: the game lets a segment be installed there, so it counts there. Flex floor and outside (EVA) tiles carry nothing.

supports.notes: An intact installed floor of any of the game's kinds on a floor tile.
An intact installed wall on a wall tile.
